title: House and Portrait
author: Lena Coldharbour
blurb: Wendell Marchetti, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
